Today’s M&A briefing — 12 deals, the strategies behind them · 14 November 2026

🔹 Aurelius (investment fund specializing) acquires Resonac's graphite division (manufactures graphite electrodes).
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: Aurelius acquires a position in an industrial supply chain with high barriers to entry, where structural demand will be accentuated by the decarbonization of steel via electric arc furnaces.

🔹 Global (british media and entertainment group, active) acquires Alight Media (british out-of-home advertising network founded).
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: Global is not acquiring locations: it is acquiring inventory that it will transform into programmatically addressable space, to compete with Google and Meta in advertising measurement and automation.

🔹 Grupo Tirant.
Grupo Tirant, a legal publishing and technology group based in Valencia (Spain), acquired elDigesto, a Chilean startup founded by lawyer Gabriel Castro, which develops legal artificial intelligence tools, access to specialized sources, and assistance for the daily work of legal professionals.

🔹 PostScriptum (family office of AI entrepreneur Peter Sarlin) takes a majority stake in Brillian (end-to-end AI implementation missions).
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: The bet is that the true value of AI in business is created in implementation, and that acquiring the best European integrators now prevents their absorption by large consulting firms or American IT service companies.

🔹 ACS.
ACS, a Spanish construction and engineering group, acquired the Voltan group, a renewable energy player.

🔹 RSK Group (global environmental consulting and engineering group, over 17,000 employees in 40 countries, founded in 1989) finalizes the acquisition of ABS Commercial Solutions (commercial consulting, compliance, training).

🔹 Shaw Gibbs (british accounting firm) acquires Calculo (audit, tax, payroll, outsourced accounting).

🔹 Activequity (investor specializing) acquires Liberty Wines (london-based importer and distributor of premium wines).

🔹 Andriani (italian producer of specialized pasta) acquires Pu-Ma Conserve (production of sauces, pestos).

🔹 Bike Republic (Colruyt Group) (bicycle retail chain belonging to the Belgian distribution group Colruyt Group) acquires four BikeFriend stores in Flanders (bicycle stores in Flanders, Belgium).
The operation strengthens Bike Republic's physical presence in Flanders.

🔹 MOVE Viaggi (expanding travel agency network in Lombardy, Italy) acquires the business of Goaltour Como (travel agency founded 37 years ago).

🔹 Büttner GmbH (gas station operator based in Leer, Lower Saxony) acquires the Otto Heinz gas station in Großheide (gas station in Großheide, Aurich district).

🔹 Grupo Tirant.

🔹 ACS.
ACS, groupe espagnol de construction et d'ingénierie, a acquis le groupe Voltan, acteur des énergies renouvelables.

🔹 RSK Group (𝑔𝑟𝑜𝑢𝑝𝑒 𝑚𝑜𝑛𝑑𝑖𝑎𝑙 𝑑𝑒 𝑐𝑜𝑛𝑠𝑒𝑖𝑙 𝑒𝑛𝑣𝑖𝑟𝑜𝑛𝑛𝑒𝑚𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑎𝑙 𝑒𝑡 𝑑'𝑖𝑛𝑔𝑒́𝑛𝑖𝑒𝑟𝑖𝑒, 𝑝𝑙𝑢𝑠 𝑑𝑒 17 000 𝑐𝑜𝑙𝑙𝑎𝑏𝑜𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑢𝑟𝑠 𝑑𝑎𝑛𝑠 40 𝑝𝑎𝑦𝑠, 𝑓𝑜𝑛𝑑𝑒́ 𝑒𝑛 1989) finalise le rachat de ABS Commercial Solutions (𝑐𝑜𝑛𝑠𝑒𝑖𝑙 𝑐𝑜𝑚𝑚𝑒𝑟𝑐𝑖𝑎𝑙, 𝑐𝑜𝑛𝑓𝑜𝑟𝑚𝑖𝑡𝑒́, 𝑓𝑜𝑟𝑚𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛).

🔹 Activequity (𝑖𝑛𝑣𝑒𝑠𝑡𝑖𝑠𝑠𝑒𝑢𝑟 𝑠𝑝𝑒́𝑐𝑖𝑎𝑙𝑖𝑠𝑒́) rachète Liberty Wines (𝑖𝑚𝑝𝑜𝑟𝑡𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑢𝑟 𝑒𝑡 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑡𝑟𝑖𝑏𝑢𝑡𝑒𝑢𝑟 𝑑𝑒 𝑣𝑖𝑛𝑠 𝑝𝑟𝑒𝑚𝑖𝑢𝑚 𝑏𝑎𝑠𝑒́ 𝑎̀ 𝐿𝑜𝑛𝑑𝑟𝑒𝑠).

🔹 Bike Republic (Colruyt Group) (𝑒𝑛𝑠𝑒𝑖𝑔𝑛𝑒 𝑑𝑒 𝑐𝑦𝑐𝑙𝑒𝑠 𝑎𝑝𝑝𝑎𝑟𝑡𝑒𝑛𝑎𝑛𝑡 𝑎𝑢 𝑔𝑟𝑜𝑢𝑝𝑒 𝑑𝑒 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑡𝑟𝑖𝑏𝑢𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑏𝑒𝑙𝑔𝑒 𝐶𝑜𝑙𝑟𝑢𝑦𝑡 𝐺𝑟𝑜𝑢𝑝) rachète quatre magasins BikeFriend en Flandre (𝑚𝑎𝑔𝑎𝑠𝑖𝑛𝑠 𝑑𝑒 𝑐𝑦𝑐𝑙𝑒𝑠 𝑒𝑛 𝐹𝑙𝑎𝑛𝑑𝑟𝑒, 𝐵𝑒𝑙𝑔𝑖𝑞𝑢𝑒).
L'opération renforce la présence physique de Bike Republic en Flandre.

🔹 MOVE Viaggi (𝑟𝑒́𝑠𝑒𝑎𝑢 𝑑'𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑛𝑐𝑒𝑠 𝑑𝑒 𝑣𝑜𝑦𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑠 𝑒𝑛 𝑒𝑥𝑝𝑎𝑛𝑠𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑒𝑛 𝐿𝑜𝑚𝑏𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑖𝑒, 𝐼𝑡𝑎𝑙𝑖𝑒) rachète le fonds de commerce de Goaltour Como (𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑛𝑐𝑒 𝑑𝑒 𝑣𝑜𝑦𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑠 𝑓𝑜𝑛𝑑𝑒́𝑒 𝑖𝑙 𝑦 𝑎 37 𝑎𝑛𝑠 𝑠𝑢𝑟 𝑙𝑒 𝑡𝑒𝑟𝑟𝑖𝑡𝑜𝑖𝑟𝑒 𝑑𝑢 𝑙𝑎𝑐 𝑑𝑒 𝐶𝑜̂𝑚𝑒, 𝐼𝑡𝑎𝑙𝑖𝑒).

🔹 Büttner GmbH (𝑜𝑝𝑒́𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑢𝑟 𝑑𝑒 𝑠𝑡𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛𝑠-𝑠𝑒𝑟𝑣𝑖𝑐𝑒 𝑏𝑎𝑠𝑒́ 𝑎̀ 𝐿𝑒𝑒𝑟) rachète la station-service Otto Heinz à Großheide (𝑠𝑡𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛-𝑠𝑒𝑟𝑣𝑖𝑐𝑒 𝑎̀ 𝐺𝑟𝑜ßℎ𝑒𝑖𝑑𝑒).

Today’s fundraising briefing — 4 deals, the strategies behind them · 14 November 2026

🔹 Gama (ultra-light deployable solar panels for satellites, French startup based in the Paris region) — €15m · Seed.
Gama pivoted from solar sails for probes to panels for satellites, a market constrained by few suppliers and lead times exceeding one year. It signed a supply partnership with Eclipse Space. Cost target: 10 $/W.
𝗨𝘀𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝘂𝗻𝗱𝘀: Construction of a factory in the Paris region (100 MW/year), recruitment of approximately 60 mechanical, electrical, and software engineers.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: Transition Ventures, Planet A, Draper Associates, Manta Ray.
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: This round funds real industrial capacity — 100 MW annually is a factory — betting that satellite demand will grow faster than the global capacity to power them.

🔹 Twin1 (AI agents associated with each employee to preserve and share institutional knowledge within companies) — $5m · Seed.
This extension brings the total seed funding to $25 M. Twin1 is already working with Shoreline Credit Union. The platform feeds each AI agent with emails, meetings, documents, and work systems of the relevant employee.
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: Curql as lead investor is a direct distribution channel to over 160 credit unions: in regulated sectors, the primary obstacle to AI is governance and compliance, which Twin1 directly addresses.

🔹 Mondrio (AI-assisted B2B pricing platform for offer development, quote optimization, discounts, and renewals, Dutch startup) — $3.75m.
Founded by Gregor Biljardt and Joep van den Nieuwenhoff, Mondrio articulates two modules: Pricing Studio (development of pricing schemes) and Deal Engine (integration of pricing intelligence into each transaction).
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: Mondrio attempts to close in real-time the often considerable gap between pricing strategy defined in committee and what actually happens in B2B commercial negotiations.

🔹 NeuralSat (orbital infrastructure combining high-speed data relays and distributed computing between satellites, for emergency response) — €2.9m · Pre-seed.
Founded in 2026 by Mohd Bilal (CEO), Rishi Jaiswal (CTO), and Manohar Karnal (COO), NeuralSat starts from the observation that the vast majority of satellites are launched without inter-satellite networking capabilities.
𝗨𝘀𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝘂𝗻𝗱𝘀: Technical feasibility validation before fundraising for constellation construction.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: Capnamic Ventures (lead investor), Bayern Kapital, ZOHO.VC, Robin Capital, BAB (Bremen development bank), KIEMIS Holding, Mission E Capital.

fr.text:
Levées de fonds : les 4 opérations chiffrées de l'édito du 14 novembre 2026.

🔹 Gama (𝑝𝑎𝑛𝑛𝑒𝑎𝑢𝑥 𝑠𝑜𝑙𝑎𝑖𝑟𝑒𝑠 𝑑𝑒́𝑝𝑙𝑜𝑦𝑎𝑏𝑙𝑒𝑠 𝑢𝑙𝑡𝑟𝑎-𝑙𝑒́𝑔𝑒𝑟𝑠 𝑝𝑜𝑢𝑟 𝑠𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑙𝑙𝑖𝑡𝑒𝑠, 𝑠𝑡𝑎𝑟𝑡𝑢𝑝 𝑓𝑟𝑎𝑛𝑐̧𝑎𝑖𝑠𝑒 𝑏𝑎𝑠𝑒́𝑒 𝑒𝑛 𝑟𝑒́𝑔𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑝𝑎𝑟𝑖𝑠𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑛𝑒) — 15 M€ · Seed.
Gama a pivoté des voiles solaires pour sondes vers les panneaux pour satellites, marché contraint par peu de fournisseurs et des délais dépassant un an. Elle a signé un partenariat d'approvisionnement avec Eclipse Space. Objectif de coût : 10 $/W.
𝗢𝗯𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗳 : Construction d'une usine en région parisienne (100 MW/an), recrutement d'environ 60 ingénieurs en mécanique, électrique et logiciel.
𝗔𝘃𝗲𝗰 : Transition Ventures, Planet A, Draper Associates, Manta Ray.
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : Ce tour finance une capacité industrielle réelle — 100 MW annuels, c'est une usine — sur le pari que la demande de satellites croîtra plus vite que la capacité mondiale à les alimenter en énergie.

🔹 Twin1 (𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑠 𝐼𝐴 𝑎𝑠𝑠𝑜𝑐𝑖𝑒́𝑠 𝑎̀ 𝑐ℎ𝑎𝑞𝑢𝑒 𝑐𝑜𝑙𝑙𝑎𝑏𝑜𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑢𝑟 𝑝𝑜𝑢𝑟 𝑝𝑟𝑒́𝑠𝑒𝑟𝑣𝑒𝑟 𝑒𝑡 𝑝𝑎𝑟𝑡𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑟 𝑙𝑎 𝑐𝑜𝑛𝑛𝑎𝑖𝑠𝑠𝑎𝑛𝑐𝑒 𝑖𝑛𝑠𝑡𝑖𝑡𝑢𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛𝑛𝑒𝑙𝑙𝑒 𝑒𝑛 𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑟𝑒𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑠𝑒) — 5 M$ · Seed.
Cette extension porte le total seed à 25 M$. Twin1 travaille déjà avec Shoreline Credit Union. La plateforme nourrit chaque agent IA des e-mails, réunions, documents et systèmes de travail du collaborateur concerné.
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : Curql comme lead investisseur est un canal de distribution direct vers plus de 160 coopératives de crédit : dans les secteurs réglementés, le premier obstacle à l'IA est la gouvernance et la conformité, que Twin1 adresse frontalement.

🔹 Mondrio (𝑝𝑙𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑓𝑜𝑟𝑚𝑒 𝑑𝑒 𝑡𝑎𝑟𝑖𝑓𝑖𝑐𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝐵2𝐵 𝑎𝑠𝑠𝑖𝑠𝑡𝑒́𝑒 𝑝𝑎𝑟 𝐼𝐴 𝑝𝑜𝑢𝑟 𝑒́𝑙𝑎𝑏𝑜𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒𝑠 𝑜𝑓𝑓𝑟𝑒𝑠, 𝑜𝑝𝑡𝑖𝑚𝑖𝑠𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒𝑠 𝑑𝑒𝑣𝑖𝑠, 𝑟𝑒𝑚𝑖𝑠𝑒𝑠 𝑒𝑡 𝑟𝑒𝑛𝑜𝑢𝑣𝑒𝑙𝑙𝑒𝑚𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑠) — 3,75 M$.
Fondée par Gregor Biljardt et Joep van den Nieuwenhoff, Mondrio articule deux modules : Pricing Studio (élaboration des schémas tarifaires) et Deal Engine (intégration de l'intelligence tarifaire dans chaque transaction).
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : Mondrio tente de fermer en temps réel l'écart souvent considérable entre la stratégie tarifaire définie en comité et ce qui se passe réellement dans les négociations commerciales B2B.

🔹 NeuralSat (𝑖𝑛𝑓𝑟𝑎𝑠𝑡𝑟𝑢𝑐𝑡𝑢𝑟𝑒 𝑜𝑟𝑏𝑖𝑡𝑎𝑙𝑒 𝑐𝑜𝑚𝑏𝑖𝑛𝑎𝑛𝑡 𝑟𝑒𝑙𝑎𝑖𝑠 𝑑𝑒 𝑑𝑜𝑛𝑛𝑒́𝑒𝑠 𝑎̀ ℎ𝑎𝑢𝑡𝑒 𝑣𝑖𝑡𝑒𝑠𝑠𝑒 𝑒𝑡 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑐𝑢𝑙 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑡𝑟𝑖𝑏𝑢𝑒́ 𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑟𝑒 𝑠𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑙𝑙𝑖𝑡𝑒𝑠, 𝑝𝑜𝑢𝑟 𝑟𝑒́𝑝𝑜𝑛𝑠𝑒 𝑑'𝑢𝑟𝑔𝑒𝑛𝑐𝑒) — 2,9 M€ · Pré-seed.
